conbody.p: Adding a short, thoughtful message to your connection request helps you explain who you are and why you’re reaching out. This can help the recipient decide whether to accept your request.

note.p: With a LinkedIn Premium membership, you have no limit on the number of personalized messages you can add to the connection requests you send.

conbody.note: Explain who you are and why you’re reaching out
Build trust when connecting with someone you don’t know yet
You can add a personalized message to up to three connection requests per month
Each message can be up to 200 characters
LinkedIn Premium members can send unlimited personalized invitations to all their connection requests (connection request limits may still apply)
This is especially useful if you’re growing your network, exploring new roles, or reconnecting with people outside your immediate circle.
What to include in your message
Keep your message short and specific. A good personalized invitation usually includes:
How you found the person or what you have in common
Why you’d like to connect now
For example, you might reference a shared role, event, group, or post you found helpful. This helps the recipient quickly understand the context of your request.
